metadata.question: Did the turbidity of the Beaufort Sea (specifically at 69.954148, -136.325766) increase between June 14, 2012, and July 5, 2012?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Primary: MODIS Aqua L3 SMI Kd_490 (turbidity proxy) around 2012-06-14 and 2012-07-05 at the point in Beaufort Sea. Use ±3 days windows; if empty, expand to ±7, ±10, ±14 days.
   - Fallback: Landsat 7 Collection 2 L2 SR to compute NDTI ((Red−Green)/(Red+Green)) as a turbidity proxy with cloud masking. Same window escalation.
2. Masking strategy
   - MODIS L3 SMI is already masked over clouds/land; just use median composite and count valid pixels.
   - Landsat: Mask QA_PIXEL cloud, cloud shadow, snow; compute NDTI on SR_B3 (red), SR_B2 (green) after scaling. Count valid pixels and report cloud-free ratio.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error
   - Accept zero/low values as valid if within expected range (Kd_490: 0–10; NDTI: −1..1).
   - If collections empty after all attempts => C1.
   - If images exist but valid pixel count is 0 after masking => C2.
   - If reduce results are null/NaN or out of valid range => C3.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

function fmt(n, d=3) {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return 'null';
  return Number(n).toFixed(d);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.325766, 69.954148]);
    const region = pt.buffer(5000); // 5 km buffer for robust sampling
    const d1 = ee.Date('2012-06-14');
    const d2 = ee.Date('2012-07-05');
    const windowDaysList = [3, 7, 10, 14];

    // Helpers
    async function modisKd490Stats(date, winDays) {
      const start = date.advance(-winDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['Kd_490']);
      const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C1', images: 0 };
      }
      const img = col.median();
      const countDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 4000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const count = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('Kd_490'));
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C2', images: size, validPix: 0 };
      }
      const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 4000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('Kd_490'));
      if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean < 0 || mean > 10) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C3', images: size, validPix: count };
      }
      return { ok: true, mean, validPix: count, images: size, method: 'AQUA_Kd490', window: winDays };
    }

    function ls7ToNDTI(img) {
      // Scale reflectance: SR * 0.0000275 - 0.2 (C02 L2)
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // Cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // Cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));     // Snow
      const green = img.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const red = img.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const ndti = red.subtract(green).divide(red.add(green)).rename('NDTI');
      return ndti.updateMask(mask);
    }

    async function landsatNDTIStats(date, winDays) {
      const start = date.advance(-winDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
      const colRaw = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region);
      const size = await getInfoAsync(colRaw.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C1', images: 0 };
      }
      const col = colRaw.map(ls7ToNDTI);
      const img = col.median();
      // Count valid pixels at 1000 m
      const countDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const validPix = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('NDTI'));
      // Total pixels (1 km grid) in region
      const totalDict = ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const totalPix = await getInfoAsync(totalDict.get('constant'));
      if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C2', images: size, validPix: 0, totalPix: totalPix || 0 };
      }
      const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('NDTI'));
      if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean < -1 || mean > 1) {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'C3', images: size, validPix, totalPix };
      }
      const cloudFreeRatio = totalPix ? (validPix / totalPix) : null;
      return { ok: true, mean, validPix, images: size, totalPix, cloudFreeRatio, method: 'LANDSAT7_NDTI', window: winDays };
    }

    async function getBestStatsForDate(date) {
      // Try MODIS Aqua Kd_490
      for (const w of windowDaysList) {
        const r = await modisKd490Stats(date, w);
        if (r.ok) return r;
        if (r.reason === 'C2') {
          // Images exist but all masked here; try larger window then fallback
          continue;
        }
        if (r.reason === 'C1') {
          // Try larger window
          continue;
        }
      }
      // Fallback Landsat 7 NDTI
      for (const w of windowDaysList) {
        const r = await landsatNDTIStats(date, w);
        if (r.ok) return r;
        // else continue escalating
      }
      // If all failed, return the strongest reason prioritizing C2 over C1, else C3
      return { ok: false, reason: 'C1' };
    }

    const r1 = await getBestStatsForDate(d1);
    const r2 = await getBestStatsForDate(d2);

    function printStats(label, r) {
      if (!r.ok) {
        console.log(`${label}: FAILED (${r.reason})`);
      } else {
        if (r.method === 'AQUA_Kd490') {
          console.log(`${label}: ${r.method}, win=±${r.window}d, images=${r.images}, validPix=${r.validPix}, Kd_490(mean)=${fmt(r.mean, 4)}`);
        } else {
          const cfr = r.cloudFreeRatio != null ? (r.cloudFreeRatio * 100.0) : null;
          console.log(`${label}: ${r.method}, win=±${r.window}d, images=${r.images}, validPix=${r.validPix}/${r.totalPix} (${fmt(cfr,1)}% clear), NDTI(mean)=${fmt(r.mean, 4)}`);
        }
      }
    }

    printStats('T1 (around 2012-06-14)', r1);
    printStats('T2 (around 2012-07-05)', r2);

    // Decision logic
    if (!r1.ok || !r2.ok) {
      // Determine best failure code
      const reasons = [r1.reason || 'C1', r2.reason || 'C1'];
      // If any C2 (images but no valid pixels) -> C2
      if (reasons.includes('C2')) {
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      // Else if any C3 -> C3
      if (reasons.includes('C3')) {
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
      // Else default to C1
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Normalize to same metric if mixed methods: we can still compare trends because both are turbidity proxies
    // We'll only compare direction (increase or not).
    const v1 = r1.mean;
    const v2 = r2.mean;

    // Validate numbers
    const invalid =
      (v1 === null || v2 === null || isNaN(v1) || isNaN(v2)) ||
      ((r1.method === 'AQUA_Kd490') && (v1 < 0 || v1 > 10)) ||
      ((r2.method === 'AQUA_Kd490') && (v2 < 0 || v2 > 10)) ||
      ((r1.method === 'LANDSAT7_NDTI') && (v1 < -1 || v1 > 1)) ||
      ((r2.method === 'LANDSAT7_NDTI') && (v2 < -1 || v2 > 1));

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = v2 - v1;
    const pct = (v1 !== 0 && isFinite(v1)) ? (diff / Math.abs(v1) * 100.0) : null;
    const metricLabel = r1.method === 'AQUA_Kd490' && r2.method === 'AQUA_Kd490' ? 'Kd_490' : 'proxy';
    console.log(`Change (${metricLabel}): Δ=${fmt(diff, 4)} (${pct !== null ? fmt(pct, 1) + '%' : 'n/a'})`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err.message || err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
